user.title: Chaac receiver
user.description: Select the serial port of the Chaac USB LoRa receiver.

history.title: Import history
history.description: Optionally upload a chaac.db from the old system. Its stations are created with their names, and their hourly history goes into the new sensors' statistics. Skip this to start with no history.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open the serial port.
error.no_response: The port opened but no Chaac receiver answered a ping.
error.invalid_history: That file is not a chaac.db with hourly samples.

data_description.auto_add: When off, only approved stations get devices. Stations heard but not approved are listed below.
data_description.approved_stations: Station UIDs (hex) allowed to create devices when auto-add is off.
